review_method: Direct visual inspection of displayed tool output and copied design-front.png using view_image. Framing coordinates are approximate human observations, not an independently measured acceptance gate.

actual_failures.consequence: Approximately 14.8% charcoal below base rather than requested 10%; no further call or postprocessing permitted.

observations.full_figure: Full hair silhouette, body, both hands, pistol, boots and base remain uncropped.
observations.front_view: Head, shoulders and hips visually square to camera; no visible three-quarter torso turn. Camera math cannot be proven from a generated raster.
observations.pose: Relaxed arms with mild elbow bends and charcoal gaps around arms and between legs.
observations.hands: Both bare hands visible, left relaxed with curled digits, right gripping pistol; no obvious missing or extra digits at this resolution. Exact five-finger topology and trigger-finger contact require independent review.
observations.pistol: In anatomical right hand (viewer left), muzzle down and outward, clear of body/feet; no firing effect.
observations.pedestal: One base, two low stacked discs, straight upper edge and no exposed stone top. Circular planform is requested and inferred, not independently provable from edge-on view.
observations.identity_and_costume: Adult woman with short dark-brown hair and slate-blue field jacket/trousers, simple pouches and plain boots. Visually distinct from owner red hair, black catsuit, wrist cuffs and hourglass emblem. No named real person requested or reference actor used; global lack of resemblance cannot be certified.
observations.background: Plain charcoal with subtle studio tonal variation, not perfectly uniform RGB. No scene, VFX, text, UI or visible logos.
observations.correction_drift: Correction slightly changes garment/face shading and small details as generative editing can; identity remains visually consistent but not pixel-locked.

selection_reason: Attempt 2 satisfies the requested approximate 6% top margin while retaining readable full figure, visible hands and edge-on base. Attempt 1 has a closer base position but fails top margin. Neither fulfills all exact framing requirements. Both originals are retained for root review.
independent_review: Pending root-coordinated review; this is worker self-review only.
